name: Theory of Computation
description: Regular languages: deterministic and non-deterministic finite automata, regular expressions, closure properties, pumping lemma, Myhill-Nerode theorem, minimal automata. Context-free languages: grammars, pushdown automata, closure properties, pumping lemma. Decidable and recognizable languages: deterministic and non-deterministic Turing machines, multi-tape Turing machines, closure properties, universal Turing machines, Church-Turing thesis. Undecidability and un-recognizability: diagonalization, mapping reductions, Rice’s theorem. Time complexity, time hierarchy theorem, NP-completeness, Cook-Levin theorem.
